candidates.title: Canada did not see historic population decline last year, StatsCan says after second look
candidates.description: Canada's population saw a slight bump in 2025, Statistics Canada says, revising a previous estimate that showed the population decreased for the first time in the country's history.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: RCMP says it still won't share more details on firearms used in Tumbler Ridge shooting
candidates.description: Advocacy groups say Canadians deserve basic facts about the weapons used in the February mass shooting in northeast B.C.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Alberta youth charged with terrorism offences related to violent online group 764
candidates.description: RCMP have charged a 17-year-old in Lethbridge, Alta., with multiple offences related to terrorism, child sexual abuse and exploitation material, and animal cruelty. The accused’s online activity was consistent with the designated terrorist group 764, investigators say.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Judge hears accounts of Calgary women, teen terrorized by serial rapist in 1980s as case nears conclusion
candidates.description: Richard Hubert Jones, 72, who faces nine charges related to three sexual assaults in the 1980s, admitted that his DNA matched the attacker's, which was collected by police from the bodies of the victims and the homes where the violent crimes took place.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Police in northern Ontario want tighter safer-supply rules to keep prescription opioids off streets
candidates.description: Prescription opioids meant to help people struggling with addiction are increasingly turning up in drug investigations in northern Ontario, according to police. The issue is a concern in other parts of Canada as well.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: CAQ Leader Fréchette blames party staff for handling of foreign interference claims
candidates.description: Coalition Avenir Québec Leader Christine Fréchette blamed members of her own party for trying to get journalists to pursue a story about foreign interference in the electoral process as she tried to distance herself on Monday from a controversy that has dogged her on the election campaign trail for days.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Severe dust pollution blowing into Alberta community downwind of the oilsands, study warns
candidates.description: New peer-reviewed research shows that Fort McKay, Alta. faces disproportionately high levels of dust pollution, frequently exceeding Alberta's regulatory guidelines for ambient air quality. Researchers say outdated monitoring standards leave the community vulnerable to intense spikes of contamination.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: More than 650,000 requests to vote by mail in referendum: Elections Alberta
candidates.description: Elections Alberta says it has received more than 650,000 requests for special ballots for the Oct. 19 referendum — a huge increase in the number of requests received for the 2023 provincial general election.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Homecoming parties in Guelph 'worst' yet and 'impacted the entire community,' mayor says
candidates.description: Guelph Mayor Cam Guthrie says this year's off-campus homecoming parties impacted the entire community and were among the worst they've seen in terms of resources needed to respond to it. Other cities in Ontario have also had their share of grief in dealing with unsanctioned student parties.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Can Saskatoon legally remove an encampment? Past court rulings have landed on both sides
candidates.description: Courts across Canada have repeatedly protected encampments when people have nowhere else to go, Saskatoon is now part of the battle.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Alberta, Ontario premiers share stage in Calgary to talk energy policy
candidates.description: Alberta Premier Danielle Smith and Ontario Premier Doug Ford are sharing a stage in Calgary today to talk energy. The leaders will be in the city's downtown to talk about how to best get Canada's natural resources to market in a world of fluctuating politics and conflicts.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 'Crypto King' Aiden Pleterski will represent himself at his fraud trial next week
candidates.description: Self-described 'Crypto King' Aiden Pleterski’s criminal fraud and money laundering trial will begin next week, after the trial judge denied a request to delay it on Monday in Ontario's Superior Court of Justice.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: How Nova Scotia became one of Canada's most expensive rental markets
candidates.description: Real estate watchers in Nova Scotia say rapidly rising rental prices show no sign of slowing down. They point to various factors, ranging from lack of tenant protections to high operating and construction costs.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: First Nation chiefs call for Indigenous-led search unit for missing persons in northern Ontario
candidates.description: First Nation leaders in northern Ontario are calling for the launch of an Indigenous-led search-and-rescue pilot program after five missing people were found dead in Thunder Bay this spring. Three of them were members of Nishnawbe Aski Nation communities. At their annual Keewaywin Conference, chiefs voted in favour of a NAN search-and-rescue pilot project. Here's what that could look like.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Alcohol is Canada’s biggest drug problem. So why aren’t people getting help?
candidates.description: Research shows alcohol causes more harm overall than any other drug in Canada. Some doctors and other advocates say people struggling with alcohol aren’t getting treatment options that are backed by science.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: How much would Quebec independence cost? An Alberta study offers clues
candidates.description: With the Parti Québécois leading in the polls and promising a third referendum, the party is facing questions about the economic impact of Quebec independence — and a new study on Alberta separation offers a sobering point of comparison.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Alleged drug trafficker Brian Da Costa denied bail again in Toronto police corruption case
candidates.description: An alleged drug trafficker accused of obtaining confidential information from a Toronto police officer, which investigators say was used in an unsuccessful conspiracy to kill a senior corrections official, was denied bail again Monday.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: What to know about Cornell's alleged frat house gang-rape case and the 'Cornell 7'
candidates.description: Investigators in New York are reopening an investigation into an alleged gang rape at Cornell University after a woman filed a lawsuit claiming the university didn't do enough to protect her.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Ukraine hit with deadly wave of Russian drone strikes in Kyiv and across the country
candidates.description: At least two people were killed when a drone hit the National Academy of Sciences in central Kyiv on Monday, as Russia pounded the heart of the Ukrainian capital with some of the most persistent drone strikes since the start of the war.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Hurricane Polo threatens Mexico's Pacific coast with landfall expected today
candidates.description: Residents of Mexico's Baja California Sur state boarded up homes and workers hauled dirt and rubble to shore up embankments as Hurricane Polo bore down on the peninsula Monday, threatening high winds, floods and mudslides. Meanwhile, Hurricane Nolo could still bring torrential rain to parts of Hawaii even as the storm edged away from the state.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Myanmar military airstrike hits market, killing at least 33 people in Rakhine state
candidates.description: An airstrike carried out by Myanmar's military near a market in territory controlled by a powerful rebel group killed at least 33 people and wounded 36 others on Monday, the group and a rescue official said.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Dutch police arrest security professional in ShinyHunters investigation
candidates.description: A Dutch man whose journey from cybercriminal to reformed security professional was widely covered in the international media has been arrested ‌as part of an investigation into the hacker group ShinyHunters, Dutch police and the man's boss said on Monday. The news comes on the heels of ShinyHunters hacking the FBI last week.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: TikTok, X reportedly barring ads for documentary about Elon Musk
candidates.description: Ads for a documentary about controversial billionaire Elon Musk have reportedly been banned from both TikTok and X but, after brief delays, are now running on YouTube and Meta's social media platforms.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Trump's tariffs are unpopular in Maine. A Republican senator may pay the price
candidates.description: The Canada-U.S. trade war is playing out amid a tight race for U.S. Senate in Maine. The election result will help determine which party controls Congress for the remainder of Donald Trump's term as president.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: British police release 5 London-based men after arrests near airbase used by U.S.
candidates.description: British police said on Monday ‌they had released on bail five ​men who were ​arrested on suspicion of terrorism and explosives ​offences near a British airbase used ‌by the U.S., although they remain under investigation.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Heavy rain, flooding kill at least 62 in northern India
candidates.description: At least 62 people have died after days of heavy rain and flooding in northern India's Uttar Pradesh state, officials said Monday.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: SpaceX sends giant Starship into orbit for the first time but ends the flight early
candidates.description: SpaceX launched its enormous Starship into orbit for the first time Monday and successfully delivered the most advanced Starlinks yet, but decided to cut short the flight.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Ukraine uses drones to make airdrops of aid to occupied city of Oleshky on brink of starvation
candidates.description: Ukrainian officials say residents in the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky are at risk of starving. With no aid coming in by road, the military used drones to deliver food supplies by air.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Multiple generations honoured at MTV VMAs as Taylor Swift, Madonna win, Dolly Parton and Nirvana remembered
candidates.description: Taylor Swift became the most-awarded artist in VMA history, Madonna won multiple times and people paid tribute to the late Dolly Parton at the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: U.K. police arrest 5 near airbase used by U.S. on suspicion of preparing a terrorist act
candidates.description: British police arrested five men near an airbase used by the U.S. on suspicion of explosive and terrorism offenses on Sunday after a tip-off that three vans had been heading to the military airfield, which has been used to strike Iran.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Rescue teams search Nepal mountain for 12 swept away by avalanche
candidates.description: Rescue teams on Monday searched for a dozen people swept away by an avalanche that killed at least two others on a Nepalese mountain during severe weather.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Northeast U.S. pummelled by wind and floods from deadly nor'easter
candidates.description: Residents of coastal communities in the U.S. northeast slogged through floodwaters for a second day as a powerful nor'easter pummelled the shoreline Sunday, knocking out power to tens of thousands of homes.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Bill Gates joins call for AI safeguards, wants to discuss concerns with Trump
candidates.description: AI requires safeguards that go beyond self-regulation, ‌Microsoft co-founder Bill Gates said in an interview that aired on Sunday, calling for legislation to be passed in Congress. A groundswell has ​risen in favour of federal intervention after OpenAI said in July an autonomous AI agent went rogue during a security test and hacked into another company
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Vucic resigns as Serbia's president, setting up election that could see him become PM
candidates.description: Serbia's populist president, Aleksandar Vucic, resigned on Sunday to pursue a bid to become the prime minister in an upcoming early parliamentary election that will test his firm rule in the Balkan country after nearly two years of protests.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: McNulty first American to win elite road race world title since Lance Armstrong in 1993
candidates.description: Brandon McNulty captured the men's elite road race on the final day of UCI Road World Championships in Montreal. McNulty, 28, became the first American to win an elite road race world title since Lance Armstrong struck rainbow gold at Oslo in 1993.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Putin appears to be eyeing NATO. The question is, will he actually attack?
candidates.description: European military experts warn that Russia is actively planning targeted aggression against NATO to test alliance solidarity. Recent high-alert incidents include a foiled explosive drone plot at a German airport and a strike near the Ukraine-Poland border targeting European VIPs. However, officials are deeply split on the immediacy of a conventional threat.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Will Meta’s data centre raise Alberta power bills? Experts say it could
candidates.description: Experts warn Meta's Sturgeon County data centre could put pressure on Alberta energy prices, despite assurances from Meta and the provincial government that Albertans won't see higher bills.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Incoming Air Canada CEO's current airline engaged in 'anti-labour' behaviour, says Canadian union head
candidates.description: The union representing Air Canada pilots says it is concerned about what it calls a "retaliatory and anti-labour" action by Scandinavian Airlines — which is currently run by Air Canada's next CEO.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: The incoming U.S. import bans on Canadian alcohol, whey, molasses and motorcycles, by the numbers
candidates.description: The United States is set to ban a select number of Canadian imports starting Tuesday, in the next escalation of a trade war that has already led to steep tariffs on goods from both sides.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: OpenAI pauses training of latest models after AI agents probed U.S. government sites in unexpected ways
candidates.description: OpenAI said it has paused training of its latest artificial intelligence models as reports of AI agents going rogue mount.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Seoul summons Ukraine envoy over North Korean prisoner-of-war row
candidates.description: Last week Zelensky revealed Ukraine had sent two captured North Koreans to South Korea - which Seoul says was meant to be a secret.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: French PM warns against escalation of school protests after 164 arrested
candidates.description: Students are protesting over issues such as overcrowded classes, but the prime minister has condemned reports of violence.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Nigerian attempts to break world record by dancing non-stop for seven days
candidates.description: Crowds have gathered in Lagos to watch Ben Dancer, who says he will carry on dancing until Tuesday morning.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Iran court upholds lashes sentence for singer who performed without hijab
candidates.description: Parastoo Ahmadi was convicted of "offending public decency" after singing while wearing a sleeveless dress during a livestreamed concert.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Four bodies found after avalanche hits Himalayan climbing group
candidates.description: Rescuers are still looking for 12 Nepalese cook staff who were preparing for climbers to ascend the Himlung Himal peak.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Plan for controversial Sydney data centre scrapped after push-back
candidates.description: Goodman Group, the property giant behind the Project Mars data centre, says the decision is due to changes to the "policy and regulatory environment".
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: US prosecutors reopen case of alleged gang rape at Cornell University
candidates.description: It comes after the woman filed a civil lawsuit alleging she was drugged and raped at a fraternity house in 2024.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Remains of dozens of suspected kidnap victims found in Nigerian forests
candidates.description: Investigations are ongoing to establish the identities of at least 28 people whose remains were recovered by police.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Trump-Xi summit: What wasn't said might matter the most
candidates.description: The most revealing thing about the summit in Washington may be what the two leaders did not say - and what we still don't know.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: One dead as nor'easter storm pummels New York and New Jersey
candidates.description: Tens of millions of people from Maine to Virginia found themselves in the path of the powerful weather system.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Venezuela releases dozens of political prisoners as election calls grow
candidates.description: A slew of dissidents being released from long-term detention comes days after the nation's interim leader met the US president.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Iranian minister says only negotiation can end conflict after Trump rejects Hormuz deal
candidates.description: The foreign minister says Tehran is waiting for an official rejection of a deal, despite the US President's comments.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Killer Christa Pike to be executed within days - but her defence say she's a victim too
candidates.description: Lawyers for Pike, who killed a fellow student in 1995, say she should get clemency and would not be sentenced to death if the crime happened today.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Woman charged with stealing from patients and staff at hospitals across Ontario
candidates.description: The 34-year-old is under investigation for incidents that began in February 2024 up until as recently as last month.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Why some Indian civil servants become heroes for doing their jobs
candidates.description: In a system often marked by red tape and exhausting delays, officers seen to be following the rules get adulation.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Before BTS and Blackpink, there was Big Bang: Now the Kings of K-pop are back
candidates.description: Big Bang played London's Tottenham Hotspur Stadium, marking a long-awaited return for the group that helped build the blueprint for modern K-pop.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Watch: From launch to fiery splashdown, SpaceX's Starship completes orbit test
candidates.description: A thunderous lift off, rapid satellite deployments and a fiery ending. That's how SpaceX's 14th launch of its Starship rocket panned out today.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Watch: Madonna and Taylor Swift win big at the MTV VMAs
candidates.description: Taylor Swift, Madonna, and LISA were among the big winners at the MTV Video Music Awards (VMAs) on Sunday evening in downtown Los Angeles.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Shipwreck found on Nantucket beach during storm
candidates.description: The so-called nor'easter storm has washed up what may be a shipwreck from the 19th century in Massachusetts, local media says.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: Your pictures of the Harvest Moon shimmering across the UK sky
candidates.description: The full Moon put on a stunning display over the skies of UK on Saturday night and here are some of your photographs.
candidates.author: BBC News

candidates.title: What we know about the suspected U.K. terror plot. And, why the Gulf remains in limbo
candidates.description: What we know — and still don't — about the suspected terror plot near a U.K. air base. Trump rejects Iran's offer to pause fighting. And CNN prepares for new owners with ties to Trump.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: U.K. examines if Iran or Russia are involved in foiled attack near base used by U.S.
candidates.description: Five men arrested on terror charges near a U.S.-run air force base were released on bail, as detectives investigate lines of inquiry, including whether a foreign state or armed group was involved.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Eviction of 87-year-old sparks protests in Madrid over housing crisis
candidates.description: Tens of thousands marched through Madrid on Saturday to protest Spain's housing crisis and the eviction of an 87-year-old woman, camping overnight in Madrid's historic Puerta del Sol plaza.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Five arrested near UK air base used by U.S. bombers in Iran war
candidates.description: U.K. police say five men were arrested on suspicion of preparation of a terrorist act after three vehicles were spotted near an air base the U.S. military has been using to launch attacks on Iran.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Amid changing dynamics in the Middle East, Turkey seeks to emerge as a leader
candidates.description: Turkey's attempts at expanding its Middle East footprint has put it in a position of power, coming head-to-head with Israel.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Playing 'La Bamba' for an hour? Must be a Mexican fandango!
candidates.description: A 300-year-old Mexican musical tradition is finding new life around the world — one sweaty, joyous, all-night fandango at a time.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Photos: This may be the most inspirational night school on Earth
candidates.description: Many thousands of boys and men in Lesotho take up the vital profession of herding but have to give up their education. A small network of schools on a shoestring budget is teaching them the ABCs.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: 5 arrested near a U.K. air base used by U.S. on suspicion of preparing a terrorist act
candidates.description: Police evacuated homes Sunday near an air base in England used by the U.S. and arrested several men over suspected explosives offenses.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: The Trump administration weakens fuel efficiency standards for new cars
candidates.description: The Trump administration says easing these standards will make cars more affordable. Critics say it's not so simple and could be costly for the environment.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Oura puts a ring on Wall Street with one of this year's biggest IPOs
candidates.description: The leading smart ring manufacturer is betting its trove of health data will be a hit with Wall Street.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: Everyone is racing to create an AI device. Meta thinks it has one
candidates.description: Tech companies are betting that people will connect with AI using something other than smartphones. Meta is going all-in on glasses, after launching its new AI agent Muse.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: 5 tips for parents worried about their kids' screen time and online safety
candidates.description: Parental monitoring can help protect kids from the harms of social media and excess screen time. Screen time boundaries plus early and open conversations about online habits can make kids less vulnerable.
candidates.author: NPR

candidates.title: From professor to patient: One man's journey on the frontier of lung cancer treatment
candidates.description: Lung cancer is still the top cancer killer, but new developments are shifting what the future might hold for patients.
candidates.author: NPR
